purpose: Editable island supplement source archive and attribution; contains no original 8K texture or application binaries.
mapping: x=(longitude+180)/360*width; y=(90-latitude)/180*height. Sample geographic extents, not camera axes. Preserve per-patch alpha.
replacement_rule: Old global draft alpha cleared within every modern detail bounds; original Day remains unchanged.

attribution: EOxCloudless https://cloudless.eox.at by EOX IT Services GmbH (Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2025)
changes: Uses current sourced OSM coastline in this detail window; replaces the older GSHHG mask here rather than translating historical pixels arbitrarily.
Disused/abandoned features and unclosed lines excluded; polygon holes retained.
EOX imagery warped from EPSG:3857 into equirectangular WGS84 and clipped to the sourced mask; transparent outside mask.

runtime_integration_note: These are the final georeferenced authoring PNG inputs, not a byte-for-byte independently reproducible complete Earth bundle. Full uses color-managed per-mip composition into affected ASTC blocks on the existing base bundle; Shared uses area integration. V105 applies old/new SCS RGB differences to the V104 result, with identical alpha, instead of compositing twice. The original textures and compression tools are not redistributed here.
